**Do I need to cite the textbook if I pull the first sentence of the description from the textbook?**

This page runs the SIR (susceptible, infected, recovered) program from the BASIC
listing below, rewritten in Python. The Python runs right here in your browser, and
the table and graph show whatever the program prints. Edit the code and press **Run**
to update them; **Reset** brings back the original program.

The model: each day, susceptible people become infected at a rate of a × S × I, and
infected people recover at a rate of b × I. In the program, `a = 0.00001` is the
transmission coefficient and `b = 1 / 14` is the recovery coefficient (an illness lasting
about two weeks). The program uses Euler's method: it computes the rates, multiplies by
the time step `deltat`, and adds the changes to S, I and R.

## Notes from the textbook

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Original BASIC program

```
 1  t = 0
 2  S = 45400
 3  I = 2100
 4  R = 2500
 5  deltat = 1
 6  PRINT t, S, I, R
 7  FOR k = 1 TO 3
 8          Sprime = -.00001 * S * I
 9          Iprime = .00001 * S * I - I / 14
10          Rprime = I / 14
11          deltaS = Sprime * deltat
12          deltaI = Iprime * deltat
13          deltaR = Rprime * deltat
14          t = t + deltat
15          S = S + deltaS
16          I = I + deltaI
17          R = R + deltaR
18          PRINT t, S, I, R
19  NEXT k
```
:::

```{=html}
<script type="module">
// ------------------------------------------------------------------
// The original program, translated line for line from the BASIC.
// ------------------------------------------------------------------
const ORIGINAL = `# Starting values
t = 0
S = 45400
I = 2100
R = 2500

# Model parameters
a = 0.00001   # transmission coefficient
b = 1 / 14    # recovery coefficient
deltat = 1    # time step, in days
steps = 3     # number of steps

print(t, S, I, R)

# BASIC: FOR k = 1 TO 3
for k in range(1, steps + 1):
    Sprime = -a * S * I
    Iprime = a * S * I - b * I
    Rprime = b * I
    deltaS = Sprime * deltat
    deltaI = Iprime * deltat
    deltaR = Rprime * deltat
    t = t + deltat
    S = S + deltaS
    I = I + deltaI
    R = R + deltaR
    print(t, S, I, R)
`;

const TIMEOUT_MS = 5000;   // stop programs that run too long (e.g. an endless loop)
const MAX_LINES = 5000;    // cap on printed lines kept for the table
const DEFAULT_HEADER = ["t", "S", "I", "R"];

const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const ta = $("sir-code"), hl = $("sir-hl"), gutter = $("sir-gutter");
const statusEl = $("sir-status"), errorEl = $("sir-error");
const runBtn = $("sir-run"), resetBtn = $("sir-reset"), autoBox = $("sir-auto");
const tableWrap = $("sir-table-wrap"), noteEl = $("sir-note"), otherEl = $("sir-other");
const chartWrap = $("sir-chart"), legendEl = $("sir-legend");

// ------------------------------------------------------------------
// Editor: a transparent textarea over a syntax-highlighted <pre>.
// ------------------------------------------------------------------
const KW = new Set(("False None True and as assert async await break class continue def del elif else " +
  "except finally for from global if import in is lambda nonlocal not or pass raise return try while with yield").split(" "));
const BI = new Set("print range len abs min max round int float str list dict sum enumerate zip".split(" "));
const esc = s => s.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;");

function highlightLine(line) {
  const re = /(#.*$)|("(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"?|'(?:[^'\\]|\\.)*'?)|(\.?\b\d[\d_]*\.?\d*(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?)|([A-Za-z_]\w*)/g;
  let out = "", last = 0, m;
  while ((m = re.exec(line))) {
    const tok = m[0];
    out += esc(line.slice(last, m.index));
    const cls = m[1] ? "c" : m[2] ? "s" : m[3] ? "n" : KW.has(tok) ? "k" : BI.has(tok) ? "b" : null;
    out += cls ? `<span class="t-${cls}">${esc(tok)}</span>` : esc(tok);
    last = m.index + tok.length;
  }
  return out + esc(line.slice(last));
}

let errorLine = null;
function paint() {
  const lines = ta.value.split("\n");
  hl.innerHTML = lines.map((l, i) =>
    `<span class="ln${i + 1 === errorLine ? " err" : ""}">${highlightLine(l) || " "}</span>`).join("");
  gutter.innerHTML = lines.map((_, i) =>
    `<span${i + 1 === errorLine ? ' class="err"' : ""}>${i + 1}</span>`).join("");
}

// Insert text in a way the browser's undo stack remembers.
function insertText(text) {
  if (!document.execCommand("insertText", false, text)) {
    ta.setRangeText(text, ta.selectionStart, ta.selectionEnd, "end");
    ta.dispatchEvent(new Event("input"));
  }
}

let tabEscaped = false;
ta.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
  if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); requestRun(true); return; }
  if (e.key === "Escape") { tabEscaped = true; return; }
  if (e.key === "Tab" && !tabEscaped && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); insertText("    "); return; }
  if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey && !e.altKey) {
    const before = ta.value.slice(0, ta.selectionStart);
    const line = before.slice(before.lastIndexOf("\n") + 1);
    let indent = line.match(/^ */)[0];
    if (/:\s*(#.*)?$/.test(line)) indent += "    ";
    e.preventDefault();
    insertText("\n" + indent);
    return;
  }
  tabEscaped = false;
});

let debounce = null;
ta.addEventListener("input", () => {
  errorLine = null;
  paint();
  if (autoBox.checked) {
    clearTimeout(debounce);
    debounce = setTimeout(() => requestRun(), 500);
  } else if (ready && !busy) {
    setStatus("Code changed. Press Run to update.");
  }
});
autoBox.addEventListener("change", () => { if (autoBox.checked) requestRun(); });

resetBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
  ta.focus();
  ta.select();
  insertText(ORIGINAL);          // goes through undo, so Ctrl/⌘+Z brings your edits back
  ta.setSelectionRange(0, 0);
  ta.scrollTop = 0;
  errorLine = null;
  paint();
  requestRun(true);
});
runBtn.addEventListener("click", () => requestRun(true));

// ------------------------------------------------------------------
// Python runs in a Web Worker so a runaway loop can't freeze the page.
// Pyodide is loaded from the site's top-level pyodide/ folder, so no internet is needed.
// ------------------------------------------------------------------
const PYODIDE_BASE = new URL("../pyodide/", document.baseURI).href;
const workerSource = `
  import { loadPyodide } from "${PYODIDE_BASE}pyodide.mjs";
  let py = null;
  const ready = loadPyodide({ indexURL: "${PYODIDE_BASE}" })
    .then(p => { py = p; postMessage({ type: "ready", version: p.version }); })
    .catch(err => postMessage({ type: "fatal", message: String(err && err.message || err) }));
  onmessage = async (e) => {
    await ready;
    if (!py) return;
    const { id, code, maxLines } = e.data;
    const lines = [];
    let truncated = false;
    const collect = s => { if (lines.length < maxLines) lines.push(s); else truncated = true; };
    py.setStdout({ batched: collect });
    py.setStderr({ batched: collect });
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const ns = py.globals.get("dict")();
    try {
      await py.runPythonAsync(code, { globals: ns });
      postMessage({ type: "result", id, lines, truncated, ms: performance.now() - t0 });
    } catch (err) {
      postMessage({ type: "error", id, lines, truncated, message: String(err && err.message || err) });
    } finally {
      ns.destroy();
    }
  };
`;
const workerUrl = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([workerSource], { type: "text/javascript" }));

let worker = null, ready = false, busy = false, pending = true, runId = 0, killTimer = null;
// pending starts true so the program runs once Python first loads.

function startWorker() {
  ready = false;
  busy = false;
  runBtn.disabled = true;
  worker = new Worker(workerUrl, { type: "module" });
  worker.onmessage = onWorkerMessage;
  worker.onerror = e => showFatal(e.message || "The Python worker failed to start.");
}

function showFatal(msg) {
  setStatus("Python unavailable");
  tableWrap.innerHTML = `<div class="sir-empty">Couldn't start Python: ${esc(msg)}<br>
    Make sure the <code>pyodide</code> folder is at the top level of the project and that you're
    viewing the page through <code>quarto preview</code> (not by opening the HTML file directly).</div>`;
}

function setStatus(s) { statusEl.textContent = s; }

function requestRun(now = false) {
  clearTimeout(debounce);
  if (!ready || busy) { pending = true; return; }
  execute();
}

function execute() {
  pending = false;
  busy = true;
  const id = ++runId;
  setStatus("Running…");
  clearTimeout(killTimer);
  killTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    worker.terminate();
    showError(`Stopped after ${TIMEOUT_MS / 1000} seconds. Check for a loop that never ends, ` +
              `or a loop with far more steps than you meant.`, null);
    setStatus("Restarting Python…");
    pending = false;
    startWorker();
  }, TIMEOUT_MS);
  worker.postMessage({ id, code: ta.value, maxLines: MAX_LINES });
}

function onWorkerMessage(e) {
  const msg = e.data;
  if (msg.type === "ready") {
    ready = true;
    runBtn.disabled = false;
    setStatus(`Python ${msg.version} ready`);
    // After a timeout restart, pending is false, so the runaway code isn't run again
    // until you edit it or press Run.
    if (pending) execute();
    return;
  }
  if (msg.type === "fatal") { showFatal(msg.message); return; }
  if (msg.id !== runId) return;

  clearTimeout(killTimer);
  busy = false;
  if (msg.type === "result") {
    clearError();
    const n = renderOutput(msg.lines, msg.truncated);
    setStatus(`Ran in ${msg.ms < 10 ? msg.ms.toFixed(1) : Math.round(msg.ms)} ms, ${n} row${n === 1 ? "" : "s"}`);
  } else {
    const { text, line } = cleanTraceback(msg.message);
    showError(text, line);
    setStatus("Error");
  }
  if (pending) execute();
}

// Turn Pyodide's long traceback into "Line N: ErrorType: message".
function cleanTraceback(raw) {
  const lines = raw.trim().split("\n");
  const last = lines[lines.length - 1] || raw;
  let line = null;
  for (const l of lines) {
    const m = l.match(/File "<exec>", line (\d+)/);
    if (m) line = Number(m[1]);
  }
  return { text: line ? `Line ${line}: ${last}` : last, line };
}

function showError(text, line) {
  errorEl.textContent = text + "\nThe table shows the last successful run.";
  errorEl.classList.add("show");
  tableWrap.classList.add("stale");
  chartWrap.classList.add("stale");
  errorLine = line;
  paint();
}

function clearError() {
  errorEl.classList.remove("show");
  tableWrap.classList.remove("stale");
  chartWrap.classList.remove("stale");
  if (errorLine !== null) { errorLine = null; paint(); }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------
// Printed lines -> table. Rows are lines where every value is a number.
// A line of names printed before any numbers becomes the header.
// ------------------------------------------------------------------
const fmt = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", { maximumFractionDigits: 2 });

function renderOutput(lines, truncated) {
  let header = null;
  const rows = [], other = [];
  for (const raw of lines) {
    const toks = raw.trim().split(/[\s,]+/).filter(Boolean);
    if (!toks.length) continue;
    const nums = toks.map(Number);
    if (nums.every(Number.isFinite)) rows.push(nums);
    else if (!rows.length && !header && toks.every(tk => /^[A-Za-z_]/.test(tk))) header = toks;
    else other.push(raw);
  }

  const cols = Math.max(0, ...rows.map(r => r.length));
  if (!header) header = cols === DEFAULT_HEADER.length ? DEFAULT_HEADER : [];
  const heads = Array.from({ length: Math.max(cols, header.length) }, (_, i) => header[i] ?? `Column ${i + 1}`);

  if (!rows.length) {
    tableWrap.innerHTML = `<div class="sir-empty">The program didn't print any rows of numbers.
      Add a line like <code>print(t, S, I, R)</code>.</div>`;
  } else {
    tableWrap.innerHTML = `<${"table"} class="sir-table"><caption class="visually-hidden">Program output</caption>
      <thead><tr>${heads.map(h => `<th scope="col">${esc(h)}</th>`).join("")}</tr></thead>
      <tbody>${rows.map(r => `<tr>${heads.map((_, i) =>
        `<td>${r[i] === undefined ? "" : fmt.format(r[i])}</td>`).join("")}</tr>`).join("")}</tbody></${"table"}>`;
  }

  noteEl.textContent = rows.length
    ? `Values rounded to 2 decimal places for display.${truncated ? ` Output was cut off after ${MAX_LINES} lines.` : ""}`
    : "";
  otherEl.hidden = other.length === 0;
  otherEl.textContent = other.length ? "Other output:\n" + other.join("\n") : "";
  renderChart(heads, rows);
  return rows.length;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------
// Graph: piecewise linear curves (straight lines between printed points), drawn as SVG.
// ------------------------------------------------------------------
const COLORS = ["#1f5f99", "#c0392b", "#2e8b57", "#8e44ad", "#d68910", "#4b5563"];

function niceTicks(lo, hi, count) {
  if (!(hi > lo)) hi = lo + 1;
  const raw = (hi - lo) / count;
  const mag = 10 ** Math.floor(Math.log10(raw));
  const r = raw / mag;
  const step = (r >= 7.5 ? 10 : r >= 3.5 ? 5 : r >= 1.5 ? 2 : 1) * mag;
  const start = Math.floor(lo / step + 1e-9) * step;
  const end = Math.ceil(hi / step - 1e-9) * step;
  const ticks = [];
  for (let v = start; v <= end + step / 2; v += step) ticks.push(Number(v.toPrecision(12)));
  return { lo: start, hi: end, ticks };
}

let lastChart = null;
let lastChartWidth = 0;
new ResizeObserver(() => {
  const w = chartWrap.clientWidth;
  if (lastChart && w !== lastChartWidth) { lastChartWidth = w; renderChart(...lastChart); }
}).observe(chartWrap);

function renderChart(heads, rows) {
  lastChart = [heads, rows];
  const cols = Math.max(0, ...rows.map(r => r.length));
  if (rows.length < 2 || cols < 2) {
    legendEl.innerHTML = "";
    chartWrap.innerHTML = `<div class="sir-empty">The graph needs at least two printed rows, each with two or more numbers.</div>`;
    return;
  }
  const W = Math.max(260, chartWrap.clientWidth - 8);
  const H = Math.round(Math.min(380, Math.max(240, W * 0.62)));
  const M = { l: 62, r: 16, t: 12, b: 44 };
  const series = [];
  for (let c = 1; c < cols; c++) {
    series.push({
      name: heads[c], col: c, color: COLORS[(c - 1) % COLORS.length],
      pts: rows.filter(r => r[c] !== undefined).map(r => [r[0], r[c]])
    });
  }
  const xs = rows.map(r => r[0]);
  const ys = series.flatMap(sr => sr.pts.map(p => p[1]));
  const xT = niceTicks(Math.min(...xs), Math.max(...xs), 6);
  const yT = niceTicks(Math.min(0, ...ys), Math.max(...ys), 5);
  const sx = x => M.l + (x - xT.lo) / (xT.hi - xT.lo) * (W - M.l - M.r);
  const sy = y => H - M.b - (y - yT.lo) / (yT.hi - yT.lo) * (H - M.t - M.b);
  const f1 = v => v.toFixed(1);

  let svg = `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" role="img" aria-label="Line graph of ${esc(series.map(sr => sr.name).join(", "))} against ${esc(heads[0])}">`;
  for (const v of yT.ticks) {
    svg += `<line class="grid" x1="${M.l}" x2="${W - M.r}" y1="${f1(sy(v))}" y2="${f1(sy(v))}"/>`;
    svg += `<text x="${M.l - 8}" y="${f1(sy(v))}" dy="0.32em" text-anchor="end">${fmt.format(v)}</text>`;
  }
  for (const v of xT.ticks) {
    svg += `<line class="axis" x1="${f1(sx(v))}" x2="${f1(sx(v))}" y1="${H - M.b}" y2="${H - M.b + 5}"/>`;
    svg += `<text x="${f1(sx(v))}" y="${H - M.b + 18}" text-anchor="middle">${fmt.format(v)}</text>`;
  }
  svg += `<line class="axis" x1="${M.l}" x2="${W - M.r}" y1="${H - M.b}" y2="${H - M.b}"/>`;
  svg += `<text x="${(M.l + W - M.r) / 2}" y="${H - 6}" text-anchor="middle">${esc(heads[0])}</text>`;
  const showDots = rows.length <= 60;
  for (const sr of series) {
    const d = sr.pts.map((p, i) => `${i ? "L" : "M"}${f1(sx(p[0]))},${f1(sy(p[1]))}`).join("");
    svg += `<path d="${d}" fill="none" stroke="${sr.color}" stroke-width="2.25" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/>`;
    if (showDots) for (const p of sr.pts)
      svg += `<circle cx="${f1(sx(p[0]))}" cy="${f1(sy(p[1]))}" r="3.5" fill="${sr.color}"/>`;
  }
  svg += `<line class="hover-rule" y1="${M.t}" y2="${H - M.b}" style="display:none"/>`;
  svg += `<rect x="${M.l}" y="${M.t}" width="${W - M.l - M.r}" height="${H - M.t - M.b}" fill="transparent"/></svg>`;

  legendEl.innerHTML = series.map(sr =>
    `<span><span class="sir-sw" style="background:${sr.color}"></span>${esc(sr.name)}</span>`).join("");
  chartWrap.innerHTML = svg + `<div class="sir-tip" hidden></div>`;

  // Hover (or touch) to read the values at the nearest printed point.
  const svgEl = chartWrap.querySelector("svg"), rule = svgEl.querySelector(".hover-rule");
  const tip = chartWrap.querySelector(".sir-tip");
  svgEl.addEventListener("pointermove", e => {
    const box = svgEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    const vx = (e.clientX - box.left) * W / box.width;
    let best = 0, bestDist = Infinity;
    rows.forEach((r, i) => { const dd = Math.abs(sx(r[0]) - vx); if (dd < bestDist) { bestDist = dd; best = i; } });
    const row = rows[best], px = sx(row[0]);
    rule.setAttribute("x1", px);
    rule.setAttribute("x2", px);
    rule.style.display = "";
    tip.innerHTML = `<strong>${esc(heads[0])} = ${fmt.format(row[0])}</strong>` + series.map(sr =>
      row[sr.col] === undefined ? "" :
      `<div><span class="sir-sw" style="background:${sr.color}"></span>${esc(sr.name)}: ${fmt.format(row[sr.col])}</div>`).join("");
    tip.hidden = false;
    const scale = box.width / W, left = px * scale + 4;
    tip.style.left = (left + tip.offsetWidth + 14 > box.width ? left - tip.offsetWidth - 14 : left + 14) + "px";
  });
  svgEl.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => { rule.style.display = "none"; tip.hidden = true; });
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------
ta.value = ORIGINAL;
paint();
startWorker();
</script>
```
